note: ORPHAN Pro 30:8 — remove falsehood from me; give me neither poverty nor riches, but my needful food.

dims.v: contentment — the prayer for sufficiency, wanting neither want nor wealth

the desire for neither poverty nor riches but only one's needful food — the contentment that prays to be spared both extremes, wanting neither the want that tempts to theft nor the wealth that tempts to deny God, asking only for enough
(the falsehood he also prays to be spared)
the contented spirit that asks only for sufficiency, fearing the perils of both want and wealth

osher (riches) — 'give me neither poverty nor RICHES; feed me with the food that is needful for me' (30:8); the prayer of contentment. Agur asks to be spared both extremes, knowing wealth tempts to deny God and want to steal (30:9). To desire only enough is a rare and wise contentment (cf 1 Tim 6:8).
